binary_equivalence_limitations: Top-level empty-archive pilot only; native recursive and prepared production admission integration remain open.

binary_interactions.decision: Keep second-target recognition optional: new-edit query time improves 8.29%, controls regress 1.14%, and exposed branches still take nine expansions. The main gain crosses the eight-expansion probe boundary: wrapped 17 to 8, direct 11 to 8. Investigate preserving unfinished acquisition continuations with no answer authority. Native checking is unchanged; alternative proofs and regressions are retained.

binary_routing.decision: The false-only priority guard is not promoted: it lowers ordinary expansion counts slightly but increases mean control/new-edit query time. Next test both polarities or justified polarity selection on the saved divergence.

bipolar_routing.decision: Both polarities remove the demonstrated sign-dependent blind spot. Do not promote: control/new-edit query time rises21.31%/18.85% and new-edit native payload35.45%. Next compare cheaper admission and shared source-bound prepared cofactors, normalization and propagation.

carried_origins.decision: Indexed origin carry preserves exact conditional supports and all native proof payloads. Charge the index and copied map containers, then select the next bottleneck from total-cost measurements; no automatic correspondence or unrestricted bound is established.

cofactor_handoff.decision: Keep optional: direct handoff lowers new-edit query time 2.66% with both orders improving, identical proof payloads and unchanged expansions. Complete worker time changes +0.15% with mixed signs. Next share the identical six-branch partition structure built four times per selected query, preserving independent source/child checks. Probe admission and continuation costs remain open.

conditional_recovery.decision: Optional missing-clause guidance with ordinary native certificates. Preserve mixed runtime/storage results and all previous proof authority.

conditional_unit_support.decision: Optional guarded unit refutations and provenance-free active cache; same conditional coverage as conditioned causal cores on exposed edits. Preserve full native checking, all donor provenance and unsupported endpoint obligations.

consequence_priority.decision: Keep priority optional: six new edits improve 4.54% query time and 3.91% native payload versus joint, and 3.34% time versus one-target; controls remain 0.80% slower than one-target. Exposed joint branches preserve proof bytes, and case61 recovers baseline proof bytes. The largest new replacement takes fewer expansions yet more time than joint. Next inspect repeated source-bound preparation and causal support in its saved six-expansion branch, acquisition index 4 with 242 remaining budget and 42 earlier native IDs.

joint_backbone.decision: Keep joint discovery optional. Exposed branch and sign variants improve 9 to 4 expansions; original query time falls 24.10% and native payload 24.86%. Same-discovery single-selected ablation takes six expansions. Six new edits regress 4.05% in query time and retain 8.65% more payload despite 58 to 55 expansions. Next compare useful versus harmful full-CNF continuations, preserving case 61 and its later-query reuse effect. No coverage or unrestricted bound is added.

joint_prefix.decision: Optional direct reuse of an already-live canonical prefix during two-consequence proof assembly. Preserve exact source assignments, name maps and native proof bytes. No new default, coverage or unrestricted bound.

leaf_handoff.decision: One-use preparation preserves all native proof payloads and checks. Charge complete cost before changing defaults; automatic correspondence and unrestricted acquisition bounds remain open.

learned_conditional.decision: Lazy conditional covers enable three exact chronological transfers and reduce 43 to 33 expansions, but query time and retained storage regress. Keep experimental; first prevent cover reconstruction from replacing an already cheap unit conflict.

live_fallback.decision: Keep live fallback optional. The boundary improves 17 to 11 expansions and 20.71% query time; six controls improve 2.58% but six fresh edits regress 3.89% with no resumption opportunity. All matched proof deltas and sidecars are identical. Next inspect joint forced binary consequences in the dominant saved partition branch, charging discovery and proof construction.

ordered_probe.decision: Retain as an optional preparation specialization. Same search and certificates as whole lookahead; evaluate measured local gains separately from its overall discovery overhead.

partial_cover.decision: Partial conditional covers reuse intact supports and acquire failed leaves with checked whole-target reconstruction. Keep the route experimental and use the paired total costs, positive controls and native payload to choose the next target.

partial_residual_study.decision: Retain as an optional negative experiment. Keep the input-safe affine policy as the performance baseline.

partition_preparation.decision: Keep optional: shared partition preparation lowers new-edit query time 6.15% under binary-frequency routing and 4.01% with cofactor handoff, preserving exact proof bytes. Full worker means regress 1.07% and 0.23%. Next inspect the saved 125-variable binary/ternary branch requiring nine expansions from its exact pre-acquisition seed.

pool_priority.decision: Optional early existing-pool lookup without recovery preserves identical compact proof bytes and avoids twelve search dispatches. Recovery remains experimental; next remove duplicated template preparation.

preimage_fusion.decision: Optional fused reconstruction of causal parent clauses. Preserve every support choice, exact full child key and native proof byte. No new default, coverage or unrestricted bound.

prepared_cofactors.decision: Do not promote: prepared reuse saves7.34% of normalizer input work on new edits but query time rises0.75%. All proof bytes and decisions match. Next compare direct prepared-child handoff and useful unit-trace reuse, while preserving cached-negative lookup and discovery priority.

prepared_partial.decision: Call-local residual and leaf preparation preserve identical partial-cover proofs, dispatches, origins and hints. Use paired costs to assess the construction saving; cold extraction and automatic guard discovery remain open.

decision.coverage: Both streams retain the same 40/48 roots and per-query statuses. The fresh unresolved roots comprise six random-three sources and shared-mix edits 34/67.
decision.finding: More checked cofactors do not improve whole-root coverage here. All eight paired solve and worker comparisons regress, while proof storage grows.
decision.next_target: Defer full-residual canonicalization and key serialization until a raw post-UP binary contradiction needs publication. Fresh worst regression case 38 normalizes 67 residuals for six refutations; 61 normalizations serve only inconclusive results. Preserve the preceding gate's decisions and fully checked certificates, with canonical SCC reconstruction on hits if needed. Compare against both handoff alone and the slower closure gate; do not assume eliminating this overhead fixes all of the regression.
decision.secondary: Binary graphs are still rebuilt on misses; investigate reusable subset models or graph structure only with explicit coordinate handling and current-clause validation. A binary model is not a full-CNF witness.
decision.status: Keep the additional closure gate experimental; do not enable it by default.

measured_result.description: Use analysis.json and next-target.json for exact means and ratios; rounded prose is descriptive.

next_target.evidence: The selected worst fresh paired regression is edit 64. Its source 63 also stops at 256 dispatches; canonical coordinates agree and exactly one clause is removed and one added. Ten checked negative origins are scanned without a plan attempt. The existing whole-plan route requires a completed checked negative origin.
next_target.limitations: No reusable-leaf count, speed gain, coverage improvement or efficient arbitrary-SAT partition has been established for unfinished origins.
requirements: Census actual checked conditional leaves before claiming they survive or improve coverage.

Classify native proof kinds. The existing partial extractor only handles empty, unit, split and component rules; unsupported endpoints, including implication certificates, remain open until a checked source-bound transport is provided.
Retain bounded source-bound branch skeletons with explicit unresolved leaves, exact guards and coordinate maps.
Invalidate deleted supports; open or stopped nodes confer no negative authority.
Recompose every split against the actual edited source with one shared acquisition budget and unchanged native checking.
Charge failed matching, extraction, retained hints, invalidation, verification, persistence and cold reconstruction; compare handoff-only and current optional policies.
next_target.title: Census reusable conditional leaves and open branch plans from unfinished origins

decision.policy: Keep lazy binary closure experimental. It improves the eager gate but remains slower than handoff-only with identical completed-root coverage; no production default changes.
decision.secondary_target: If binary recognition is revisited, census checked current-subset model reuse before rebuilding SCC graphs; a binary witness never certifies the full CNF.

probe_handoff.decision: Retain exact child preparation reuse as an optional, measured policy. Compare both payload caps; neither changes native decisions, proof bytes, retained authority or coverage.

probe_lifetime.decision: Keep all four policies experimental. Early release saves acquisition time versus 2 MiB retention but has mixed signs against original 4 MiB retention. Cleanup alone does not improve solve mean. The pending cap changes scope; neither the full-visit envelope nor the target allocation trace demonstrates a substantial memory saving. Proof storage and structural coverage are unchanged.

probed_partition_study.decision: Optional supplied-candidate probe/partition pilot. Keep the affine baseline until broader discovery and cost evidence.

ranked_binary_targets.decision: Experimental bounded target rankings; retain baseline pending total-cost and broader transfer evidence.

refined_origins.decision: Bounded chronological admission permits finer covers from recomposed results. Native checks remain the authority; any measured gains are workload-specific and must include larger discovery, hints and publication costs.

residual_transport_study.decision: Optional transport study. Keep the input-safe affine policy as baseline until total-cost and broader coverage gains are established.

template_preparation.decision: Within-call source-bound preparation removes 71 repeated checks and cofactor constructions while preserving all native bytes. Keep experimental; no end-to-end gain or broader SAT coverage claim.

transported_partition_study.decision: Residual-level supplied-candidate pilot; keep the affine baseline pending net-cost and automatic-discovery evidence.

unit_cover_gate.decision: A checked unit gate avoids three unnecessary cover attempts and preserves two useful transfers, but gated learning remains slower than baseline. Next reuse intact branches of partially broken covers; keep recognition, acquisition and full recomposition costs visible.

whole_affine.decision: Retain bounded whole-input affine completion as an optional integrated policy; keep its measured coverage and all total-cost comparisons separate from unrestricted SAT claims.

whole_discovery.decision: Keep optional: earlier completion and smaller retained proofs, but no distinct-root coverage gain and higher solve/query time.

whole_pool_priority.decision: Keep explicit arbitration and its miss costs. Complete-pool priority avoids known unnecessary expansion while preserving partial fallback; this adds no distinct-root coverage.

whole_proof_reuse.decision: Keep optional: partial proof frontiers add exposed coverage, but recognition and poor priority can displace cheaper complete reuse. Preserve the fresh regressions.
